title: Incremental update and preservation host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli update passes; pdfxi update appends an incremental revision, validates the prefix/chain/pages/text and writes the result; STD-010 moves to verified.
notes: Adds the pdfxi update host over Document::set_info + save_incremental + validate_incremental, with an explicit prefix/page/text fallback for hybrid /XRefStm sources.
